description: Create a new portfolio named 'Starter_Positions' and manually populate it with starter positions based on the current watchlist. The 'My Watchlist' contains 5 stocks: AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, and NVDA. For EACH of these 5 stocks, record a 'Buy' transaction in the new portfolio with exactly 1 unit (share) at a price of $150.00. Use the default date and fees ($0).
